name: Wichita Falls Convention and Visitors Bureau
tagline: Wichita Falls area of Texas U
description: Wichita Falls Convention and Visitors Bureau is a working farm in 1002 5th Street, TX. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
